points.title: as ... as ... 和…一样
points.explanation_zh: 表示两者程度相同：as + 形容词/副词原级 + as。否定式 not as/so ... as 表示「不如」。

examples.en: She runs as fast as her brother.
examples.zh: 她跑得和她哥哥一样快。

examples.en: This book is not as interesting as that one.

points.title: 比较级 + than
points.explanation_zh: 两者比较用比较级加 than。比较级前可用 much / a little / even 修饰程度。

examples.en: This problem is much easier than the last one.
examples.zh: 这道题比上一道容易得多。

points.title: the more ..., the more ... 越…越…
points.explanation_zh: 「the + 比较级, the + 比较级」表示一方随另一方程度变化。

examples.en: The more you practice, the better you speak.

points.title: so ... that ... 如此…以至于
points.explanation_zh: so + 形容词/副词 + that 从句，表示结果。so 后面接形容词或副词，接名词时要用 such。

examples.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep at once.
examples.zh: 他太累了，立刻就睡着了。

points.title: such ... that ... 如此…以至于
points.explanation_zh: such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that 从句。名词是复数或不可数时不加冠词。

examples.en: It was such a good film that I watched it twice.
examples.zh: 这部电影太好看了，我看了两遍。

points.title: so that 以便（目的状语）
points.explanation_zh: so that 引导目的状语从句，从句中常用 can / could / may / might。

examples.en: Speak louder so that everyone can hear you.
examples.zh: 说大声点，好让大家都能听见。

points.title: too ... to ... 太…而不能
points.explanation_zh: too + 形容词/副词 + to do，形式肯定、意义否定。

examples.en: The box is too heavy to carry.

points.title: enough to do 足以…
points.explanation_zh: enough 修饰形容词/副词时放在其后：adj./adv. + enough + to do。修饰名词时放在名词前。

examples.en: He is old enough to go to school.

points.title: not only ... but also ... 不但…而且…
points.explanation_zh: 连接两个并列成分；连接主语时谓语与靠近的主语一致（就近原则）。not only 位于句首时句子要部分倒装。

examples.en: She is not only smart but also hardworking.

points.title: both ... and ... 两者都
points.explanation_zh: 连接两个并列成分，作主语时谓语用复数。

examples.en: Both Tom and Jerry like cheese.
examples.zh: 汤姆和杰瑞都喜欢奶酪。

points.title: either ... or ... 要么…要么…
points.explanation_zh: 表示两者选其一；作主语时谓语与靠近的主语一致（就近原则）。

examples.en: Either you or I am wrong.

points.title: neither ... nor ... 既不…也不…
points.explanation_zh: 表示两者都否定；作主语时谓语与靠近的主语一致（就近原则）。

examples.en: Neither he nor his parents were at home.

points.title: would rather 宁愿
points.explanation_zh: would rather do sth. 宁愿做某事；would rather do A than do B 宁愿做 A 也不做 B。

examples.en: I would rather stay home than go out in the rain.
examples.zh: 我宁愿待在家里也不愿冒雨出门。

points.title: prefer A to B 更喜欢 A
points.explanation_zh: prefer + 名词/doing + to + 名词/doing，表示两者中更喜欢前者；prefer to do rather than do 也常用。

examples.en: I prefer tea to coffee.

points.title: used to / be used to / be used for
points.explanation_zh: used to do 过去常常做（现在不做了）；be/get used to doing 习惯于做；be used for doing 被用来做。三者含义完全不同，注意区分。

examples.en: I used to get up early.
She is used to living alone.

points.title: as soon as 一…就…
points.explanation_zh: 引导时间状语从句；主句是将来时时，从句用一般现在时表将来（主将从现）。

examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.

points.title: hardly ... when ... 刚…就…
points.explanation_zh: hardly + 过去完成时 + when + 一般过去时。hardly 位于句首时要部分倒装。

examples.en: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.

points.title: no sooner ... than ... 一…就…
points.explanation_zh: no sooner + 过去完成时 + than + 一般过去时；no sooner 位于句首时要部分倒装。

examples.en: No sooner had he left than it began to rain.

points.title: It takes sb. + 时间 + to do 花费
points.explanation_zh: It takes/took sb. + 时间 + to do sth. 表示做某事花某人多少时间。spend / cost / pay 的搭配各不相同。

examples.en: It took me two hours to finish the homework.
examples.zh: 我花了两个小时完成作业。

points.title: spend ... on / (in) doing 花费
points.explanation_zh: sb. spend + 时间/钱 + on sth. 或 + (in) doing sth.。主语必须是人，这一点与 it takes / sth. costs 不同。

examples.en: She spends an hour reading every day.

points.title: there be 存在句
points.explanation_zh: 表示「某地有某物」；be 与靠近的名词保持一致（就近原则）。注意与 have（拥有）区分。

examples.en: There is a book and two pens on the desk.
examples.zh: 桌上有一本书和两支钢笔。

points.title: have been to / have gone to
points.explanation_zh: have been to 去过（人已回来）；have gone to 去了（人还没回来）。

examples.en: He has been to Paris twice.
He has gone to Paris.
examples.zh: 他去巴黎了（人不在这里）。

points.title: stop doing / stop to do
points.explanation_zh: stop doing 停止正在做的事；stop to do 停下来去做另一件事。

examples.en: He stopped smoking last year.
He stopped to smoke.

points.title: remember doing / remember to do
points.explanation_zh: remember doing 记得做过某事（已发生）；remember to do 记得要去做某事（未发生）。

examples.en: I remember locking the door.
Remember to lock the door.

points.title: forget doing / forget to do
points.explanation_zh: forget doing 忘记做过某事（事已做）；forget to do 忘记去做某事（事没做）。

examples.en: Don't forget to send the email.

points.title: look forward to doing 期待
points.explanation_zh: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词，不接动词原形。

examples.en: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.

points.title: be worth doing 值得做
points.explanation_zh: sth. is worth doing，用主动形式表达被动含义，doing 后不再接宾语。

examples.en: This museum is worth visiting.

points.title: can't help doing 忍不住
points.explanation_zh: can't help doing 忍不住做某事；注意区分 can't help (to) do 不能帮忙做某事。

examples.en: I couldn't help laughing.

points.title: had better do 最好…
points.explanation_zh: had better + 动词原形，表示建议；否定式为 had better not do。

examples.en: You'd better take an umbrella.

points.title: Why not ...? 何不…？
points.explanation_zh: Why not + 动词原形 = Why don't you + 动词原形，表建议。

examples.en: Why not go for a walk?

points.title: What / How about ...? …怎么样？
points.explanation_zh: about 是介词，后接名词或动名词，用于提出建议或征求意见。

examples.en: What about playing basketball after school?

points.title: if 条件句：主将从现
points.explanation_zh: if 引导真实条件句时，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时。if 还可引导虚拟条件句，表示与事实相反的假设。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

points.title: unless 除非 (= if ... not)
points.explanation_zh: unless 引导条件状语从句，相当于 if ... not；从句同样遵循主将从现。

examples.en: You'll miss the bus unless you hurry.
examples.zh: 除非你快点，否则你会错过公交车。

points.title: although 不与 but 连用
points.explanation_zh: although/though 引导让步状语从句，同一句中不能再用 but；同理 because 不与 so 连用。

examples.en: Although it was late, he kept working.
examples.zh: 虽然很晚了，他仍继续工作。

points.title: because 不与 so 连用
points.explanation_zh: because 引导原因状语从句，同一句中不能再用 so。回答 why 提问必须用 because。

examples.en: Because he was ill, he didn't come.

points.title: wish 后的虚拟语气
points.explanation_zh: wish 表示难以实现的愿望：对现在用过去时（be 用 were），对过去用过去完成时。注意与 hope（可实现的希望）区分。

examples.en: I wish I were taller.
I wish I had studied harder.
examples.zh: 我真希望当初更努力学习。

points.title: suggest 的宾语从句用 (should) do
points.explanation_zh: suggest / insist / demand / order 等词后的宾语从句用 should + 动词原形，should 可省略。suggest doing 也很常用。

examples.en: I suggest that he (should) see a doctor.

points.title: make / let / have sb. do 使役动词
points.explanation_zh: 使役动词 make / let / have 后接不带 to 的不定式；但被动语态中 to 要还原：be made to do。

examples.en: The teacher made us clean the classroom.

points.title: see sb. do / doing 感官动词
points.explanation_zh: 感官动词 see / hear / watch / notice 后接 do 表示看到全过程，接 doing 表示看到正在进行。

examples.en: I saw him cross the street.
examples.zh: 我看见他过了马路（全过程）。

examples.en: I saw him crossing the street.

points.title: in order to 为了
points.explanation_zh: in order to do 表目的，可置于句首或句中；否定式 in order not to do。

examples.en: He got up early in order to catch the first bus.
examples.zh: 为了赶上头班车，他起得很早。
